rationale: The aluminium delay forces us to re-plan ORD-8001-TIER1 alongside several standard panel orders. SCN-A prioritizes the tier-1 shipment at the cost of leaving a press idle before material release and pushing lower-priority work later. SCN-B improves throughput and resource use but explicitly allows the tier-1 order to miss its window, which we cannot choose autonomously. SCN-C protects the tier-1 commitment while keeping both presses reasonably loaded, but introduces more changeovers and coordination; this trade-off between simplicity, throughput, and coordination needs your judgment.
options_for_planner: SCN-A: Protect ORD-8001-TIER1 first at material release; one press sits idle before stock arrives and some standard orders are pushed later, but the tier-1 SLA is clearly protected.
SCN-B: Maximize total panel throughput and machine/labor utilization; both presses run as soon as material arrives, but ORD-8001-TIER1 misses its SLA window.

SCN-C: Start ORD-8001-TIER1 at material release on one press and clear standard work in parallel on the other; tier-1 is protected and overall utilization is good, at the cost of extra coordination and setup churn.
